knowledge:
- key_parameters: channels=A character vector to restrict EMD distance calculations to specific markers/channels ;; verbose=Logical indicating whether to print progress messages during distance calculation ;; seed=An integer seed for the stochastic Smacof algorithm to ensure reproducible MDS projections ;; nDim=An integer specifying the exact number of dimensions for the MDS projection ;; targetPseudoRSq=A numeric target for the pseudo R-square (default 0.95) used to automatically determine the number of projection dimensions ;; pData=A data frame containing sample metadata (phenoData) for coloring or labeling points ;; biplot=Logical indicating whether to overlay a correlation circle of external variables on the MDS plot ;; extVariables=A matrix or data frame of external sample statistics (e.g., channel medians) to correlate with MDS axes ;; arrowThreshold=A numeric threshold (default 0.8) to filter out shorter arrows in bi-plots ;; loadExprMatrixFUN=A user-defined function to dynamically load expression matrices from disk for heavy datasets ;; BPPARAM=A BiocParallel parameter object (e.g., SnowParam()) to parallelize distance matrix computation
- alternatives: The documentation does not mention alternative packages for EMD-MDS cytometry visualization, but notes that standard flowCore structures (flowSet/flowFrame) are preferred, while generic R matrices can be used as a flexible alternative.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have multiple cytometry samples (e.g., CyTOF or flow cytometry) and want to identify quality control issues (such as batch effects or outlier samples) or visually check for sample clusters that align with your experimental design.
- pitfalls: Heavy datasets with many samples can cause memory exhaustion if loaded entirely into RAM; use dynamic loading and parallelization to mitigate this. The Smacof algorithm for MDS is stochastic, so always set a fixed seed for reproducibility. An MDS projection computed directly in 2 dimensions (nDim = 2) is not identical to the first two axes of a higher-dimensional projection (e.g., nDim = 4). Bi-plots can become unreadable if too many arrows are displayed; adjust the arrowThreshold or use bi-plot wrapping to split statistics.

workflows.name: standard_cytometry_flow
workflows.intent: Perform low-dimensional projection and visualization of cytometry samples from a flowSet object, including distance calculation, MDS projection, quality diagnostics, and bi-plot axis interpretation.
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate pairwise Earth Mover's Distances (EMD) between samples using pairwiseEMDDist. ;; 2. Analyze individual marker contributions to the distance matrix using distByFeature and ggplotDistFeatureImportance. ;; 3. Compute the metric MDS projection using computeMetricMDS. ;; 4. Plot the MDS projection with sample metadata using ggplotSampleMDS. ;; 5. Assess projection quality using a Shepard diagram with ggplotSampleMDSShepard. ;; 6. Calculate channel summary statistics using channelSummaryStats. ;; 7. Generate bi-plots to interpret projection axes using ggplotSampleMDS with external variables. ;; 8. Plot marginal densities of key markers using ggplotMarginalDensities.
workflows.code:
pwDist <- pairwiseEMDDist(
    BCRXL_fs_trans,
    channels = chMarkers,
    verbose = FALSE
)
pwDistMatrix <- as.matrix(pwDist)
DF <- distByFeature(pwDist)
DF[order(DF$percentage, decreasing = TRUE),]
pBar <- ggplotDistFeatureImportance(pwDist)
mdsObj <- computeMetricMDS(pwDist, seed = 0)
show(mdsObj)
ggplotSampleMDS(mdsObj)
p12 <- ggplotSampleMDS(
    mdsObj,
    pData = phenoData,
    projectionAxes = c(1,2),
    pDataForColour = "group_id",
    pDataForLabel = "patient_id"
)
ggplotSampleMDSShepard(mdsObj)
medians <- channelSummaryStats(BCRXL_fs_trans, 
                               channels = chLabels, 
                               statFUNs = median)
ggplotSampleMDS(mdsObj,
                pData = phenoData,
                pDataForColour = "group_id",
                displayPointLabels = FALSE,
                displayArrowLabels = TRUE,
                repelArrowLabels = TRUE,
                biplot = TRUE,
                extVariables = medians)
ggplotMarginalDensities(
    BCRXL_fs_trans, 
    channels = chLabels,
    pDataForColour = "group_id",
    pDataForGroup = "sample_id")

workflows.name: large_dataset_parallel
workflows.intent: Calculate pairwise sample distances for large datasets by dynamically loading samples from disk and parallelizing computations to save memory and time.
input: fileNames (character vector of file paths to transformed sample RDS files on disk)
workflows.stages: 1. Set up parallel execution parameters using BiocParallel::SnowParam. ;; 2. Compute pairwise EMD distances using pairwiseEMDDist with a custom loading function and parallel backend.
workflows.code:
bp <- BiocParallel::SnowParam(
    stop.on.error = FALSE,
    progressbar = TRUE)
pwDistLast <- suppressWarnings(pairwiseEMDDist(
    x = nSample,
    channels = chMarkers,
    loadExprMatrixFUN  = function(exprMatrixIndex, files, channels, markers){
        ff <- readRDS(file = files[exprMatrixIndex ])
        exprMat <- flowCore::exprs(ff)[, channels, drop = FALSE]
        colnames(exprMat) <- markers
        exprMat
    },
    loadExprMatrixFUNArgs = list(
        files = fileNames, 
        channels = chLabels,
        markers = chMarkers),
    BPPARAM = bp))

workflows.name: generic_expression_matrices
workflows.intent: Run the CytoMDS visualization workflow using a generic list of standard R expression matrices instead of flowCore objects.
input: exprMatrixList (list of standard R matrices, one per sample, with cells as rows and features as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate pairwise EMD distances from the list of expression matrices using pairwiseEMDDist. ;; 2. Compute the metric MDS projection using computeMetricMDS. ;; 3. Plot the MDS projection using ggplotSampleMDS. ;; 4. Calculate summary statistics across matrices using channelSummaryStats. ;; 5. Generate faceted bi-plots using ggplotSampleMDSWrapBiplots.
workflows.code:
pwDistExpr <-  pairwiseEMDDist(
    exprMatrixList
)
mdsObjExpr <- computeMetricMDS(pwDistExpr, seed = 0)
show(mdsObjExpr)
phenoDataExpr <- data.frame(sampleId = seq(nSample), cond = conditions)
p12 <- ggplotSampleMDS(
    mdsObjExpr,
    pData = phenoDataExpr,
    projectionAxes = c(1,2),
    pDataForColour = "cond",
    pDataForLabel = "sampleId"
)
statFunctions <- list(mean = base::mean,
                      std_dev = stats::sd)
chStatsExpr <- channelSummaryStats(exprMatrixList,
                                   statFUNs  = statFunctions)
p <- CytoMDS::ggplotSampleMDSWrapBiplots(
    mdsObj = mdsObjExpr,
    extVariableList = chStatsExpr,
    pData = phenoDataExpr,
    projectionAxes = c(1,2),
    pDataForColour = "cond",
    displayPointLabels = FALSE,
    repelArrowLabels = TRUE,
    ncol = 2,
    arrowThreshold = 0.9
)
